study: Established supervised SAM source pilot; CE-only perturbation + AdamW, no novel algorithm claim
reused_control: shared128 ordinary24 from SWAD source; exact first-epoch replay required
validation: next cyclic source user; four train, one validation, one diagnostic only after selection
rho_rationale: single conventional author-example value; no diagnostic choice or radius search
sam_objective: CE gradient global-L2 normalization over all parameters, same batch and CPU dropout RNG both passes, stop gradient through perturbation; ordinary AdamW after exact restoration; no coupled L2 in perturbation
zero_gradient: zero perturbation; finite zero gradients still passed to AdamW once
compute_control: erm48:48 single-pass epochs with cosine over48 and tail25..48, same batch and source sampling rule; matches approximate forward/backward count but not wall time or optimizer updates; sam24 uses24 two-pass epochs, tail13..24
primary_selection: fixed dense tail per actual optimizer update
secondary_selection: earliest minimum validation CE including epoch0; never swap primary after observing diagnostic scores
stop_on_failed_gate: No rho/decay/seed/tail grid or full-eight expansion of this fixed hypothesis
pass_next_step: same-protocol eight-user controls and independent seeds; SAM performance alone is not a novel contribution
persistence: everyepoch segment, source orders, full AdamW/scheduler/CPU RNG/best/tail, selected weights, IDs/logits/config/source hashes; epoch atomic resume; lock queue
limitations: six repeatedly researched development users; single seed; old8fold scores not comparable; CE+decoupledAdamW differs author coupledL2; SAM known not original; no mainpaper fulltext claim
